scheme_name: Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses
other_conditions: Parent must have a life membership of the Karnataka State Teachers' Welfare Fund
Student must have passed each year or semester of the course on the first attempt
Student must have studied from 1st to 10th standard in government or aided schools in Karnataka
Applicant must have availed an educational loan from a nationalized bank for professional education in medicine or engineering
The educational loan must be taken for courses within India
Only one child per family can avail of the financial assistance
Assistance is only available for final‑year students in vocational medical, engineering, or postgraduate programs
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance up to ₹50,000 covering the interest component of educational loans from nationalised banks.
